description: The port's recover on a file cut off during its creation, in both versions, made with raw ops. It scans as it always does: it finds the last trailer that verifies, cuts the file back to it, writes its end as the committed size, and opens it. A new database whose committed size wasn't written yet, with the trailer of its empty root whole, becomes that new database with the file's own file ID and hash ID, where a reopen would create it again with those given to Database.init (recovery-cut-during-creation). With that trailer cut short, there's nothing to recover, so it raises InvalidDatabase and leaves the file as it is. No sync made these files, so this holds on every storage kind, a storage that replaces the file on a full copy included (D55). It was the first half of recover-without-first-commit--port, which has what recover makes of a full copy that didn't finish. recover is only in what the port does, so this is a script only the port runs, whose oracle is run --port.
